description: One segment of a TmSegmentedControl: the label a reader sees and the value the control reports, plus the optional icon, count, badge, disabled state and tab-panel id. A count and a badge are ordinary text inside the option, so they are part of the segment's accessible name — a screen reader reads "Inbox 12" rather than an unlabelled 12.

members.name: Label
members.description: The visible label of the segment, rendered as text (never as markup) and used verbatim as the option's accessible name.

members.name: Value
members.description: The value this segment reports through TmSegmentedControl.Value. Compared with EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default, so a record or an enum works as naturally as a string.

members.name: Icon
members.description: Optional icon name (see IconNames) shown before the label. The icon is decorative and always aria-hidden: it never carries the only copy of the label.

members.name: Count
members.description: Optional count shown as a small numeric suffix ("Inbox 12"). It is data, not decoration: it renders as text and stays inside the segment's accessible name. Null renders no count.

members.name: Badge
members.description: Optional short badge shown after the label for a state word the host owns ("New", "Beta"). It is text, not a colour-only cue, and stays inside the segment's accessible name.

members.name: IsDisabled
members.description: When true the segment cannot be selected and is skipped by the arrow keys, Home and End. A disabled segment still renders, because removing it would renumber every neighbour and move the selection under the reader's finger.

members.name: PanelId
members.description: Id of the panel this segment owns, used only with Role=Tabs: it becomes the tab's aria-controls. Null falls back to TmSegmentedControl.PanelId, and with neither the tab carries no aria-controls at all.
